The first elected mayor of Kathmandu in 1953 was Janak Man Shrestha, chosen by the council in an indirect election. Bishweshwar Prasad Koirala is better known as a prime minister, so he is unlikely to be the mayor. My earlier answer of Padma Ratna Tuladhar was probably wrong. I'm going from memory and the team's shortlist, not a source I checked.
